feature: Picking a clip no longer repaints its whole track (pass 27)
summary: On a busy track, picking a clip, unpicking it, cutting it or moving the pointer onto another clip no longer redraws the picture of every clip on that track. The window's own work for a pick dropped by about 4 ms, and an unpick and a blade by a few more.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Measured on the probe with an edits-only speed walk on the 6 minute reference edit, three runs with the change and three without, and the speed walk against its baseline. The reference edit's folder for File > Open: ~/Library/Caches/Photonz Reference Edit/Photonz Dev

try.do: Open the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev with the button below.
Press Space to play, then click a clip on V1 while it plays.
Look closely at the picked clip: one name, one blue ring, its grips, nothing doubled behind it.
Click a different clip on V1, then click an empty spot in the timeline.
Slide the pointer slowly along V1 over several clips while it plays.

evaluate: Does a picked or hovered clip on V1 look exactly as it did before, with no ghost of its name or edges behind it?
Does play stay smooth while you slide the pointer along a busy track?
Does picking a clip while it plays feel any quicker to you, or is the hitch still there?
rough: Edits with a clip picked still miss the 16 ms bar: a pick's own pass is 15 to 29 ms, a pick from one clip to another 25 to 31, unpick 30 to 33, blade 23 to 24, and the longest pass of a pick from nothing is a later one where a panel section lands (33 to 50 ms). That is this task's own bar (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed).

The rest of a pick is spread thin across SwiftUI: its accessibility layer walks about 956 responders for each new control (about ten walks a pick), and AppKit rechecks the title bar's drag area whenever the panel adds controls. That accessibility work is switched on by a system accessibility client on the Mac, not by the walk, so a person pays it too. No single app piece left is over 2 ms.
Worst scrub lag 1 is still not reached; this pass did not work on scrubbing (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed).
